scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @autojobs/dashboard build && corepack pnpm --filter @autojobs/worker build
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm --filter @autojobs/dashboard typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter @autojobs/worker typecheck
scripts.deploy:worker: corepack pnpm exec wrangler deploy --config worker/wrangler.toml
scripts.build:dashboard:pages: cd apps/dashboard && corepack pnpm exec next-on-pages .
scripts.migrate:apply: corepack pnpm exec wrangler d1 migrations apply --config worker/wrangler.toml --database-name autojobs
